scientific_integrity: Full labelled finite-volume count and all-q entropy proved analytically; exact finite checks are supplementary, not exhaustive for unbounded sizes.
scientific_limitations: Strictly energy-lowering adjacent colour exchanges on periodic uniform ferromagnetic rings; neutral moves excluded; no fixed-population entropy or relaxation-law claims. A plausible 1995 Potts paper was not fully accessible; independent originality verification remains outstanding.
title: Quartic metastable entropy for colour-conserving Potts exchange on a ring
